Maya (People Ops): Heads up — we've updated benefits eligibility rules for variable-hour employees in the handbook. TL;DR: 24 hrs/week average over a 3-month lookback -> eligible for prorated benefits. New guidance + manager attestation process here: https://redwood.hr/handbook/benefits-eligibility. Please review your teams and complete the attestation form by Fri 04/05. I'll run a CSV export with roster tags by EOD tomorrow.

Liam (Manager): Thanks — will review. For contractors converted to FT last month, do they need retroactive attestation?

Maya (People Ops): Good question. If conversion date is before the Q1 payroll close (03/31), mark as eligible and note conversion date in the attestation form. If conversion is after payroll close, we'll treat as an exception — ping me and we'll route to benefits ops.

Sonia (Manager): :raised_hands: I'll need the CSV with a weekly-hours breakdown per person. Can you include a contractor-conversion flag and hire-date column?

dev-bot: Export job started: benefits-roster-2467891234.csv (s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/04/). ETA ~2m.

Elliot (People Ops): Posted a short training module "Benefits eligibility + attestation" — 8-min microlearning + quiz. Finishing the module auto-populates the attestation form for managers. Link: https://learn.redwood.com/courses/benefits-eligibility. Please nudge direct reports who are part-time.

Harper (Engineer): If someone is split across two teams (0.5 on Team A, 0.6 on Team B), do managers indicate split allocation or do we sum total hours? Also who signs?

Maya (People Ops): Sum hours across all teams to determine eligibility. The manager who submits payroll (payroll owner) should sign the attestation. If an employee has split ownership, both managers should add notes and indicate percentage allocation in the form. We'll reconcile during benefits onboarding.

Liam (Manager): Completed my attestations for 5 folks just now. Left notes for two with conversions and one pending hours confirmation. Form confirmation number: ATT-2026-0048.

Sonia (Manager): I'll drop by office hours tomorrow at 10:30 PT to go over a couple of weird cases. Can you add the meeting link to the thread?

Maya (People Ops): Office hours link: https://meet.redwood.com/people-ops/dropin — recording enabled. If you need bulk changes instead of manual edits, attach your CSV here (format: email,hours_avg_3mo,conversion_date,notes) and I'll process. Example CSV export command if you want to re-run locally:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/04/benefits-roster-2467891234.csv ./ && csvcut -c email,hours_avg_3mo,conversion_date,notes benefits-roster-2467891234.csv > manager-ready.csv
```

Liam (Manager): :thumbsup:
